HDR course options
A Higher Degree by Research gives you the chance to explore your passion and deepen your expertise alongside internationally recognised researchers. Browse our research courses to find the right fit for you.
Doctor of Philosophy
An advanced research degree involving independent, supervised study and a thesis that makes an original contribution to knowledge. Available across all UWA disciplines, including creative practice options.
Professional Doctorates
Designed for experienced professionals, these programs combine advanced coursework with a research thesis tailored to industry or leadership needs.
Master of Philosophy (MPhil)
A program of independent, supervised research where you’ll demonstrate advanced, integrated knowledge in your field. Creative practice options are also available.

Higher Degree by Research
How to find a supervisor and project
Finding a supervisor and project that align with your research interests is an important first step in your Higher Degree by Research. Supervisors provide guidance on your topic, project design and dissertation, while existing projects may offer a clear path in your chosen field. Explore current opportunities or connect with potential supervisors to get started.
Search projectsContact a supervisor
Your next step
From finding a supervisor to preparing your research proposal, discover what you need to know before applying for a Higher Degree by Research at UWA.
How to apply
Graduate Research School
The Graduate Research School provides induction, candidature advice, assistance and professional development opportunities to ensure you can make the most of your research journey.
Learn more
Make key contributions
Explore your area of interest in depth and make a meaningful contribution to knowledge, guided by world-leading experts.
High employability and transferable skills
HDR graduates are in demand across many industries. You'll build sought-after skills including critical thinking, problem solving, communication, project management and evidence-based decision-making.
Career progression
A research degree is essential for a career in academia and increasingly valued across other sectors. Many professionals return to research study mid-career to enhance their opportunities.
Internships and other partnerships to expand networks
Students are supported to undertake research internships with industry partners or join existing programs. Many have industry experts as part of their supervisory team.

A common misconception is that a PhD will be all-consuming and take over your life. It doesn’t have to be this way. There are many ways to conduct research and communicate with supervisors and a healthy, balanced approach to life and research brings the most positive experience and outcomes.
Dr Kelsie Prabawa-Sear
PhD candidate at UWA
Scholarships and fees
UWA offers a range of generous scholarships, including stipends valued at $39,253 per annum (2027). Domestic applicants may be eligible for a Research Training Program (RTP) Fee Offset, and some international applicants can access fee scholarships.
Robert Street Prize
Awarded annually, the Robert Street Prize recognises the most outstanding PhD thesis at UWA, celebrating academic excellence at the highest level.
GRS Dean's List
Exceptional research theses may be nominated for an Honourable Mention in the Graduate Research School Dean’s List, a prestigious recognition of research excellence.

World-class facilities
